title: Docker section not finding binary
body:
**Describe the bug**

After the recent release of goreleaser v0.132.0, it seems that the `dockers` section can no longer find my templated binary name (though it can find it just fine in v0.131.1).

**To Reproduce**

```yaml
# This is an example goreleaser.yaml file with some sane defaults.
# Make sure to check the documentation at http://goreleaser.com
project_name: gowebapptemplate

before:
  hooks:
    - go get
    - ./install-dep.sh
    - make build-ui
    - go mod tidy
    - docker login registry.gitlab.com -u terrabitz -p {{ .Env.GITLAB_TOKEN }}
builds:
  - env:
      - CGO_ENABLED=0
    goos:
      - freebsd
      - windows
      - linux
      - darwin
    binary: "{{.ProjectName}}"
archives:
  - replacements:
      darwin: macOS
      linux: Linux
      windows: Windows
      386: i386
      amd64: x86_64
checksum:
  name_template: "checksums.txt"
snapshot:
  name_template: "{{ .Tag }}-next"
changelog:
  sort: asc
  filters:
    exclude:
      - "^docs:"
      - "^test:"
      - "^chore:"
nfpms:
  -
    # Replacements for GOOS and GOARCH in the package name.
    # Keys should be valid GOOSs or GOARCHs.
    # Values are the respective replacements.
    # Default is empty.
    replacements:
      amd64: 64-bit
      386: 32-bit
      darwin: macOS
      linux: Linux

    # Your app's vendor.
    # Default is empty.
    vendor: Hack_and_Sla.sh
    # Your app's homepage.
    # Default is empty.
    homepage: https://hackandsla.sh

    # Your app's maintainer (probably you).
    # Default is empty.
    maintainer: Trevor Taubitz <terrabitz@protonmail.com>

    # Your app's description.
    # Default is empty.
    description: A template for golang web apps

    # Your app's license.
    # Default is empty.
    license: MIT

    # Formats to be generated.
    formats:
      - deb
      - rpm

    # empty_folders:
    #   - "/var/log/gowebapptemplate"

    # config_files:
    #   "etc/example-config.yaml": "/etc/gowebapptemplate/gowebapptemplate-config.yaml"

dockers:
  - # GOOS of the built binary that should be used.
    goos: linux
    # GOARCH of the built binary that should be used.
    goarch: amd64
    binaries:
      - "{{ .ProjectName }}"
    # Path to the Dockerfile (from the project root).
    dockerfile: Dockerfile
    image_templates:
      - "terrabitz/{{.ProjectName}}:{{ .Tag }}"
      - "terrabitz/{{.ProjectName}}:v{{ .Major }}"
      - "terrabitz/{{.ProjectName}}:v{{ .Major }}.{{ .Minor }}"
      - "terrabitz/{{.ProjectName}}:latest"
      - "registry.gitlab.com/terrabitz/{{.ProjectName}}:{{ .Tag }}"
      - "registry.gitlab.com/terrabitz/{{.ProjectName}}:v{{ .Major }}"
      - "registry.gitlab.com/terrabitz/{{.ProjectName}}:v{{ .Major }}.{{ .Minor }}"
      - "registry.gitlab.com/terrabitz/{{.ProjectName}}:latest"
    build_flag_templates:
      - "--pull"
      - "--label=org.label-schema.build-date={{.Date}}" 
      - "--label=org.label-schema.name={{ .ProjectName }}"
      - "--label=org.label-schema.url='{{ .GitURL }}'" 
      - "--label=org.label-schema.vcs-ref={{ .ShortCommit }}"
      - "--label=org.label-schema.vcs-url='{{ .GitURL }}'" 
      - "--label=org.label-schema.vendor='hack_and_sla.sh'" 
      - "--label=org.label-schema.version={{ .Version }}"
      - "--label=org.label-schema.schema-version=1.0"
      - "--build-arg=BIN={{ .ProjectName }}"

```

**Expected behavior**

Goreleaser should be able to find a binary by templated name.

**Environment (please complete the following information):**

- OS: Docker
- GoReleaser Version v0.132.0
